import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Standardize case for categorical columns
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].str.strip().str.title()
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].fillna('Unknown').str.strip().str.title()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows, keep first occurrence
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count orders per category
    counts = df.groupby('Category').size().to_dict()
    return counts
